item.title: ICE agent in fatal Minneapolis shooting was hurt in a traffic stop in 2025
item.description: Jonathan Ross, an ICE officer who was dragged and injured in a traffic stop last year, fired his Taser at the suspect and later killed Renee Nicole Good with his service weapon after she tried to drive away from him.

item.title: What’s coming to Indianapolis Home Show, returning for 104th year
item.description: The Indianapolis Home Show will return for its 104th year from Jan. 16 to 25 at the Indiana State Fairgrounds & Event Center. Learn more about the Lakeside Living attractions, celebrity guests, culinary demonstrations from Indianapolis chefs, and the Children's Entrepreneur Market.

item.title: Immigration agent wounds 2 in Portland, Oregon, shooting
item.description: A U.S. immigration agent shot and wounded a man and a woman in Portland, Oregon, prompting local officials to call for calm after the ICE shooting death of a Minnesota woman a day earlier, while the Portland Mayor called for ICE to halt all operations in the city until an investigation can be completed.

item.title: Hendricks County center starts new program for troubled teens
item.description: The Willow Center in Pittsboro, Indiana, has launched a 10-week intensive outpatient program for adolescents aged 13-17 with mental health and substance use challenges. It offers nine hours of group therapy each week, and individual and family counseling. A master's degree-level clinician oversees the program.

item.title: House passes bill to extend ACA subsidies, defying GOP leadership
item.description: The House passed legislation to extend expired health care subsidies for those who get coverage through the Affordable Care Act, with the help of a bipartisan coalition of Republicans and Democrats, in a rebuke of Republican leadership.

item.title: Drunk driver, 18, charged after fatal crash in Madison County
item.description: Aidan Patterson, 18, was arrested and charged with several offenses, including operating a vehicle while intoxicated causing death, after crashing head-on with a Jeep Wrangler driven by Nancy Staley, 56, who was killed at the scene.
